title: thelypteris marginalis
intro: Thelypteris marginalis, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat inflammation, reduce fever, and aid in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris marginalis include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate pain and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
